content:
#1 Hi, good afternoon, everyone!

A big logic and applications and analytic philosophy community in Brazil is seeking to make an open copyleft collaborative encyclopedia in Portuguese to help enthusiasts to find more information on topics in logic studied in Brazil and collect sources in the language (for those who aren't fluent in English).

We seek to host the website in the domain of a university's logic, mathematics or philosophy department we choose and some have already shown their interest in hosting it, but we couldn't find anyone available with knowledge in the languages and tools used in the nLab repository ( https://github.com/ncatlab/nlab ) to make a backend for it and implement it.

Sadly I could be considered a "mouse pusher" and I have little technical knowledge in this stuff, and also are most of my colleagues. I don't know if the nLab community would approve of that and if this post wouldn't be considered the result of laziness or being too pushy, but I've trying to make this project work for the last 2 weeks and it's losing steam, so I am getting somewhat desperate (which is sad, as I consider this project very promising). Could someone help? If someone responsible for managing the website's more technical side sees this, would it be a problem to share most of the backend so implementing this would be more straightforward?

I appreciate the attention and I'm sorry if this is the wrong place to talk about this or if this is not a reasonable thing to ask.

I wish everyone a great weekend!

#2 We had many discussions on the nForum, the outcome of which appears to be that it would be desirable for the nLab to switch to a modern wiki software, like MediaWiki. nLab’s fork of Instiki is unmaintained and slow. Adding or modifying existing functionality is difficult.

So perhaps installing MediaWiki with MathJax enabled would a much easier way forward.
